description_en: Retrieves an available CIDR block from an IPAM pool
description_zh: 获取IPAM地址池可用的CIDR地址段
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam get-ipam-pool-next-available-cidr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --cidr-block 172.68.0.0/26 --cidr-mask 26 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIpamPoolNextAvailableCidr

parameters.description_en:
The region of the IPAM pool.

> If the IPAM pool has a region property, this parameter specifies the region where the pool is active. If the IPAM pool does not have a region property, this parameter specifies the managed region of IPAM.
parameters.description_zh:
IPAM地址池所在地域。
> 当IPAM地址池具备地域属性时，该参数为IPAM地址池生效地域；当IPAM地址池不具备地域属性时，该参数为IPAM托管地域。
